2608.18521.title: Which Negatives Matter? Ask Your Text Encoder: Adaptive Similarity Margins for Dense-Caption Retrieval
2608.18521.paper_summary: Dense-caption retrieval has recently been improved by introducing segmentation, edge maps, LLM-filtered captions, and cross-modal modules into contrastive fine-tuning. However, these methods largely inherit the same InfoNCE objective, whose optimization can prematurely saturate under a strong pre-trained initialization: on dense captions, the loss falls below 10^{-3} on 80% of batches within the first epoch, while its gradient reaches exact zero in fp32 in 47% of measurements. We find that this behavior is closely related to the large number of near-duplicate captions in dense-caption benchmarks, where a few highly similar negatives remain unresolved after the easy majority has already been separated. As a remedy, we introduce HN-CLIP, which uses the text encoder's own text-text geometry to construct per-negative adaptive similarity margins. Specifically, a detached caption-similarity matrix is added to the negative logits, assigning larger margins to more similar captions without mining, synthesizing, or resampling negatives. The resulting objective requires only one caption-similarity matrix and a masked logit addition during training, with no auxiliary data, additional parameters, offline preprocessing, or inference-time overhead. Extensive experiments on four dense-caption retrieval benchmarks show that HN-CLIP improves over the strongest competitors by +2.4--+4.3 R@1 while training 2.4x faster than GOAL and 5.4x faster than StructXLIP. Moreover, the proposed objective improves all six tested fine-tuning frameworks on the in-domain benchmarks and reaches the strongest full-data baseline with only 20% of the training data.
2608.18521.paper_summary_zh: 密集標題檢索最近透過引入分割、邊緣圖、LLM過濾的標題和跨模態模塊來改善對比微調。<lb/>然而，這些方法在很大程度上繼承了相同的InfoNCE目標，其優化在強大的預訓練初始化下可能會過早飽和：在密集標題上，損失在第一個時期的80%批次中降至10^{-3}以下，而其梯度在47%的測量中達到精確的零值。<lb/>我們發現，這種行為與密集標題基準中大量近重複標題密切相關，其中少數高度相似的負樣本在簡單的多數已經被分離後仍然未解決。<lb/>作為補救措施，我們引入了HN-CLIP，它利用文本編碼器自身的文本-文本幾何來構建每個負樣本的自適應相似性邊界。<lb/>具體而言，將一個獨立的標題相似性矩陣添加到負邏輯中，為更相似的標題分配更大的邊界，而無需挖掘、合成或重新抽樣負樣本。<lb/>所得到的目標在訓練期間只需要一個標題相似性矩陣和一個掩蔽的邏輯加法，無需輔助數據、額外參數、離線預處理或推理時間的開銷。<lb/>在四個密集標題檢索基準上進行的廣泛實驗表明，HN-CLIP在強競爭者中提高了+2.4--+4.3 R@1，同時訓練速度比GOAL快2.4倍，比StructXLIP快5.4倍。<lb/>此外，所提出的目標在內部基準上改善了所有六個測試的微調框架，並且僅使用20%的訓練數據達到了最強的全數據基線。
